credits_text: THE FIRST THING YOU LEARN ABOUT EVIL... IT COMES IN THREES. A NAYLA AL KHAJA FILM. DARK DUNES AND NAYLA AL KHAJA FILMS IN ASSOCIATION WITH SULTAN SAEED AL DARMAKI AND MUNA EASA AL GURG. PRESENTS JEFFERSON HALL, FATEN AHMED, NOURA ALABED, SAUD ALZAROONI. SCREENPLAY BY NAYLA AL KHAJA AND BEN WILLIAMS. MUSIC BY VLADIMIR PERSAN, PANTAWIT KIANGSIRI. EDITED BY YANN MALCOR, SEBASTIAN FUNKE, HANOZ NAVYAR. PRODUCTION DESIGNER AHMED HASAN. DIRECTOR OF PHOTOGRAPHY NIK ALLEN. PRODUCED BY SULTAN SAEED AL DARMAKI, JEAN-CHARLES LEVY, DANIEL ZIRILLI, NAYLA AL KHAJA. EXECUTIVE PRODUCERS MUNA EASA AL GURG, SULTAN SAEED AL DARMAKI, CHRISTIAN PETER, JEFFERSON HALL, SIDHARTH THAKKER, RASIK THAKKER. MATERIAL BY JOHN COLLEE, MASOUD AMRALIA AL ALI, CHRISTIAN PETER. DIRECTED BY NAYLA AL KHAJA.
